name: dsh-comfyui
description: ComfyUI as a surface the agent can BUILD against: seven `comfy_*` tools over the machine's own ComfyUI (Desktop, portable or a server on loopback) that turn a small, readable project spec into a real workflow.json + prompt.json, validate it against the live node catalog the server reports (`/object_info`) with ComfyUI's own error vocabulary, queue it (`/prompt`) and report what came out of `/history`, and a `comfy_test` that compiles the whole shipped example library and, when a server answers, runs it - each item reporting the rung it actually reached (v1-structural, v2-schema, v3-queued, v4-executed). Seven tools: comfy_status, comfy_nodes, comfy_project, comfy_validate, comfy_run, comfy_test and comfy_cli (which drives the user's own comfy-cli as a second test path and never installs anything). Six bundled skills teach the fundamentals, the two workflow formats, the HTTP API as this install has it, comfy-cli across platforms, authoring a node CLASS, and the project dialect. Host-only: one row, no route, no browser half, zero npm dependencies, no bundled engine, nothing started on its own.
